providersPage.title: BetInsight | Betting Providers
providersPage.metaDescription: Choose BetInsight betting providers by country and availability
providersPage.logoAria: Go to the BetInsight landing page
providersPage.heading: Our Betting Providers
providersPage.intro: Before we show you providers, confirm your country. You can then choose all providers approved for your country, approved providers with crypto payments, or a selection with no preference.
providersPage.countryCopy: You confirm this selection yourself. No Make or Google Sheet lookup is triggered for this step.
providersPage.confirmedCopy: This selection is only used for the current provider display.
providersPage.filterHeading: Which providers would you like to see?
providersPage.filterCopy: The selection is checked only against the central BetInsight country list.
providersPage.allowedCopy: Shows only providers that BetInsight has recorded as verified for your selected country.
providersPage.cryptoCopy: Additionally filters approved providers for crypto support confirmed by BetInsight.
providersPage.anyCopy: BetInsight shows you a suitable selection from the providers approved for your country.
providersPage.legal1: The BetInsight country list is our own maintained selection and is not legal advice or a regulatory guarantee. Providers, domains, payment methods and authorisations can change.
providersPage.legal2: Until a country or provider has been verified, the default rule is not to display it. Partner and referral links will be added separately later and do not change country eligibility.
providersPage.footer: © 2026 BetInsight Club · Betting Providers by Country
providersPage.unverified: BetInsight has not yet recorded verified providers for {{location}}. No providers are displayed until the review is complete.
providersPage.noAllowed: There are currently no approved providers recorded for {{location}}.
providersPage.noCrypto: There is currently no approved provider with confirmed crypto payments recorded for {{location}}.
providersPage.futureLink: Partner or referral links will be added separately later.
providersPage.loadError: Country list could not be loaded
